$comment: Every label the issue forms, the format checks and teamrig's import use. Type labels are set by the issue forms; priority, area and state labels need triage rights, so only maintainers and the GitHub watcher set them. tools/ci/github-format.test.ts holds the forms to this list.

labels.name: task
labels.description: Type: work to do that is not a bug or a new capability

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Type: a new capability or a change in behaviour

labels.name: area:hooks
labels.description: Area: the hooks, guards and refusals

labels.name: area:register
labels.description: Area: tasks, the inbox and the register

labels.name: area:budget
labels.description: Area: usage limits, pacing and the budget

labels.name: area:github
labels.description: Area: GitHub sync, issues and pull requests

labels.name: area:docs
labels.description: Area: the docs, the guide and the README

labels.name: area:ci
labels.description: Area: CI, the local gate and the release tools

labels.name: needs-format
labels.description: State: a section of the issue form is missing or empty

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: State: another issue or pull request already covers this

labels.name: teamrig
labels.description: State: accepted, so teamrig imports it as a task
